title.en: Compute S.D. for raw, discrete and grouped data

say.en: Mean deviation drops the signs by force. Squaring the deviations removes them in a way algebra likes, and gives the most used measure of spread: the standard deviation. In this lesson: Define S.D. and variance.
Compute S.D. for raw, discrete and grouped data.
Use the step-deviation method.

body.en: *Standard deviation* σ (Karl Pearson, 1893) is the positive square root of the mean of the squared deviations from the arithmetic mean: $\sigma = \sqrt{\sum (x - \bar{x})^2 / n}$. Its square $\sigma^2$ is the variance. A useful form is $\sigma^2 = \sum x^2/n - \bar{x}^2$: the mean of squares minus the square of the mean.
body.kn: ಮಾನಕ ವಿಚಲನೆ σ ಎಂದರೆ ಅಂಕಗಣಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿಯಿಂದ ವಿಚಲನೆಗಳ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಸರಾಸರಿಯ ಧನ ವರ್ಗಮೂಲ. ಅದರ ವರ್ಗ σ² ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಾಂಕ. σ² = ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಸರಾಸರಿ − ಸರಾಸರಿಯ ವರ್ಗ.

say.en: Standard deviation sigma (Karl Pearson, 1893) is the positive square root of the mean of the squared deviations from the arithmetic mean: \sigma = \sqrt{\sum (x - \bar{x})^2 divided by n}. Its square \sigma^2 is the variance. A useful form is \sigma^2 = \sum x^2 over n - \bar{x}^2: the mean of squares minus the square of the mean. Always taken about the mean.
say.kn: ಮಾನಕ ವಿಚಲನೆ sigma ಎಂದರೆ ಅಂಕಗಣಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿಯಿಂದ ವಿಚಲನೆಗಳ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಸರಾಸರಿಯ ಧನ ವರ್ಗಮೂಲ. ಅದರ ವರ್ಗ sigma squared ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಾಂಕ. sigma squared equals ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಸರಾಸರಿ - ಸರಾಸರಿಯ ವರ್ಗ.

say.en: Variance equals sigma squared.

A larger sigma means a flatter, wider curve. Here are two curves with the same mean and sigma one and two.
For grouped data use step deviations d equal to x minus A over h. Then sigma is h times the root of the mean of d squared minus the square of the mean of d.

body.en: S.D. is independent of change of origin but not of scale: if $y = (x - A)/h$ then $\sigma_x = |h|\,\sigma_y$. The S.D. of a constant is zero. For a frequency distribution use $\sigma^2 = \sum f x^2/N - \bar{x}^2$, with class mid-points as x.
body.kn: ಮಾನಕ ವಿಚಲನೆ ಮೂಲ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯಿಂದ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ, ಆದರೆ ಮಾಪನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯಿಂದ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರವಲ್ಲ: y = (x − A)/h ಆದರೆ σₓ = |h|σᵧ. ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕದ ಮಾನಕ ವಿಚಲನೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

say.en: S.D. is independent of change of origin but not of scale: if y equals (x - A)/h then \sigma x = |h|\,\sigma y. The S.D. of a constant is zero. For a frequency distribution use \sigma^2 = \sum f x^2 over N - \bar{x}^2, with class mid-points as x. Adding a constant: sigma unchanged.
say.kn: ಮಾನಕ ವಿಚಲನೆ ಮೂಲ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯಿಂದ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ, ಆದರೆ ಮಾಪನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯಿಂದ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರವಲ್ಲ: y equals (x - A)/h ಆದರೆ sigma x = |h| sigma ᵧ. ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕದ ಮಾನಕ ವಿಚಲನೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Find the variance and S.D. of 6, 8, 10, 12, 14.
Mean equals 50 over 5 equals 10.
Squared deviations: 16, 4, 0, 4, 16; sum equals 40.
Variance equals 40 over 5 equals 8.
S.D. = the square root of 8 equals 2.83.
So the answer is Variance equals 8; S.D. = 2.83.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Find the mean and S.D.: 0-10 5, 10-20 8, 20-30 15, 30-40 16, 40-50 6.
Mid-points 5, 15, 25, 35, 45. Take A equals 25, h equals 10: d equals minus 2, minus 1, 0, 1, 2.
Σfd equals minus 10 minus 8 plus 0 plus 16 plus 12 equals 10; Σfd squared equals 20 plus 8 plus 0 plus 16 plus 24 equals 68; N equals 50.
Mean equals 25 plus 10 times 10 over 50 equals 27.
sigma equals 10 times the square root of (68 over 50 - (10 over 50) squared) equals 10 times the square root of 1.32 equals 11.49.
So the answer is Mean equals 27; S.D. = 11.49.
